title: Style is Everything
description:
Once per Scene, when you **do something in an unnecessarily dramatic manner**, you may mark a Condition and reset Panache to equal your cha.

While you have Panache, when you **Trade Blows** using a **precise** weapon, you can roll+CHA  (instead of +DEX), and you may spend 1 Panache to gain **adv** on the roll.

title: Fly Into the Face of Danger
description: When you **Defy Danger** **by attempting something you've never tried before**, after the roll you may spend 1 Panache to treat a 6- as if it were a 7-9, or treat a 7-9 as if it were a 10+.

outcomes.text: When you **Trade Blows**, after you roll you can spend 1 Panache to do one of the following:
bullets: Disarm — ✴On a 10+, you can choose to have your opponent drop something they're holding (instead of the other choices)
Feint — **pierce** your opponents's armor, ignoring it for this blow
Parry — Reduce **dmg** received by your CHA, to a minimum of 0

title: Very Intricate Backstory
description: You can have two Struggles active at the same time. Now or the next time you **Make Camp**, clear a locked Condition (if possible) or **Level Up** and Reveal a Struggle.

title: Watch Me Shine
description: When you **draw attention by doing something unnecessarily dramatic**,you may spend 1 Panache to roll+dex.

bullets: Defuse or intensify a situation (your call)
Your allies are ignored; they get an opportunity
Your drama isn't interrupted, by word or by violence

outcomes.text: The attention is followed by violent action; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.
